title: Chinese Lamb Zha Jiang Mian
description: A classic Chinese stir-fry dish made with lamb and noodles, served in a savory and slightly sweet sauce.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt and pepper.
Cook the mian according to package instructions.
Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the lamb and cook until browned.
Add the zha, jiang, and soy sauce, and stir-fry until the sauce has thickened.
Combine the cooked mian and lamb mixture, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Transfer the wok to the oven and roast for 5 minutes.
